newsitem.title: QATAR: SQUASH-FITTER, STRONGER JANSHER EASES THROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-FITTER, STRONGER JANSHER EASES THROUGH.

text.p: Jansher Khan opened his campaign for a fifth consecutive Qatar international squash crown on Saturday with a 15-9 17-14 15-7 win over England's Mark Cairns.
The world champion said after his 54-minute triumph that he had put behind him the shock defeat by Australia's Rodney Eyles in the Hong Kong Open final in August.
"I just had a bad day then, but it made me work harder afterwards. I feel mentally and physically stronger now and I put in more time in training.
"Two or three years ago, I would train for three of four hours a day. Now I practise for between four and six hours."
